title: (Pwn2Own) NVIDIA GPU Display Drivers Video Encoder Improper Update of Reference Count Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of NVIDIA GPU Display Drivers. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system, even if only within a container, in order to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the handling of memory buffers in encode pipelines. A crafted IOCTL request can force the NVIDIA GPU driver to incorrectly update a reference count. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of the kernel on the target host system.
addtionnal_details:
NVIDIA has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at:
https://nvidia.custhelp.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/5861
